Los Gatos Orthopedic Sports Therapy is a physical therapist owned rehabilitation center. We are backed by a first class team of highly trained physical therapists and athletic trainers with specializations in sports rehabilitation and strength and conditioning.

People come to physical therapy because they hurt, not because they feel good. You likely came to this site seeking answers about your pain or injury. Our experienced team has the knowledge, skill and motivation to relieve your pain and get you back in action. Come in and experience for yourself the benefits of physical therapy.
